theme_and_concept.visual_mood: Maroon and Ivory, Indian heritage luxury, temple-jewellery warmth, high-end editorial.

rules.alignment: Center alignment for hero and marquee, left alignment for editorial text and product descriptions.

primary.description: Rich Maroon for branding, primary buttons, and strong accents.

accent.description: Gold accent for diamond dividers, fine borders, or highlighting.

rules.background: The entire app should feel warm, bathed in Ivory (#F6EDE2). Do not use stark white (#FFFFFF) unless inside a specific isolated product card.
rules.text: Never use pure black. Use #2A1F1D (Warm Charcoal) for body text to maintain the luxury warmth.

visual_enhancers.borders: Fine hairline rules. Use 1px solid #DBCDC0 or #963E35/20. No thick borders.
visual_enhancers.dividers: Use a delicate SVG diamond motif (<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M12 2L22 12L12 22L2 12L12 2Z"/></svg>) horizontally centered, often with hairline rules on either side.
visual_enhancers.image_frames: Images should have elegant, intentional placeholder frames. Use aspect-ratios like 3:4 or 4:5 for editorial look. Add subtle inset borders or classic arched clip-paths for certain portrait images.
visual_enhancers.buttons: Pill-shaped or sharp rectangular buttons. Primary: Maroon background, Ivory text. Hover: slightly lighter maroon. Secondary: Transparent background with fine maroon border.

layouts.spacing: Generous Spacing Philosophy. Use 2-3x more spacing. Sections should have py-24 or py-32.
layouts.grid: Bento-style or high-asymmetry for editorial sections. For product listings, 3 or 4 columns with gap-8.

motion.hero_reveal: Kinetic masked line-by-line headline reveal. Overflow hidden on wrapper, y: '100%' to y: '0%' with easing.
motion.scroll_reveal: Subtle fade up and slight y-translation on scroll for images and text blocks.
motion.parallax: Subtle parallax on the hero image or background elements.
motion.marquee: One slow editorial marquee using react-fast-marquee or framer-motion. Text should be uppercase, tracking wide.

Home.Hero: Split layout or centered. Headline 'Timeless Elegance, Crafted for You.' Masked text reveal. Diamond divider. Gold pendant photo on silk.
Home.Marquee: Slow moving, maroon text on ivory, or ivory on maroon. Words: EXQUISITE CRAFTSMANSHIP • HERITAGE DESIGNS • TIMELESS ELEGANCE
Home.Collections: Gold Jewellery / Silver Jewellery split cards. Large images, elegant overlay.
Home.Trust_Badges: 4 items in a row. Certified Authenticity, Exquisite Craftsmanship, Secure Payments, Trusted by Thousands. Thin lucide-react icons.
Home.Featured_Products: Carousel or 3-column grid previewing the inner pages.
Home.About_Teaser: A short manifesto paragraph with an elegant image.
Home.Footer: Maroon background (#963E35) with ivory text. Quick links, customer service, and newsletter signup form (Input + Button).

Product_Listing.Sidebar: Filters: Categories, Metal Purity (18K, 22K, 24K checkboxes), Price range slider.
Product_Listing.Main: Sort dropdown (Shadcn Select), Product grid, 'Load More' button.

About_Us.Layout: Editorial layout. Brand story with large typography.
About_Us.Manifesto: Numbered chapters (e.g., 01. THE ORIGIN, 02. THE CRAFT). Asymmetrical image placement.

Contact_Us.Layout: Elegant form saving to DB. Shadcn Form components. Generous padding, minimalist inputs (border-bottom only or very subtle full border).

hero_pendant_on_silk.description: Diamond/silver necklace on black mannequin draped with maroon silk. Perfect for hero.

gold_collection_model.description: Woman wearing a green sari and gold jewelry. Fits Indian heritage.

gold_necklace_macro.description: Person wearing Indian style gold necklace.

setup: Install react-fast-marquee for the editorial marquee.
Install lucide-react for thin, elegant icons.
Configure Tailwind config with the custom colors (Maroon: #963E35, Ivory: #F6EDE2, Gold: #D4AF37, Charcoal: #2A1F1D).
Import 'Playfair Display' and 'Outfit' fonts in index.html or global CSS.
development_rules: CRITICAL: Do NOT use a fully transparent header. Use backdrop-blur with a slight ivory/cream tint (e.g., bg-[#F6EDE2]/80).
CRITICAL: Do NOT use 'Inter' for headings. Must use 'Playfair Display'.
Set the global background to Ivory (#F6EDE2) and text to Charcoal (#2A1F1D).
For image placeholders, use the provided Unsplash URLs. Style the containers with a 1px solid #DBCDC0 border to make them look like intentional elegant frames.

Add a diamond SVG icon (<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="currentColor" class="w-4 h-4 text-accent"><path d="M12 2L22 12L12 22L2 12L12 2Z"/></svg>) as a frequent divider element between sections or headings.
Build the layout using React Router to navigate between Home, Shop (Listing), About, and Contact pages.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations separate good from extraordinary.
